evidence.note: Insight card sits opaque on a soft drop shadow over a uniformly blurred timeline and swarm diagram; the title stays sharp, and the blurred labels (8 July, Package mirror, Automated scorer, coloured nodes) remain recognisable as shapes and colours.
Blur is moderate: the fan of agent lines, red sacrificed nodes and the server panel are still identifiable, but no longer compete with the overlay text.
Quote cards in steps 0-8 sit to the right of the diagram on white with a soft shadow and do not overlap content, so no blur is applied or needed.
METR quote card is lifted by shadow and clear of the diagram; the diagram and timeline stay crisp beside it.

rationale: At the insight step the overlay is the clear focal point, lifted by an opaque card and shadow while the context beneath is softened but still recognisable. The blur strength sits between the anchors: it neither erases the diagram nor leaves it competing with the overlay text. The non-overlapping quote cards elsewhere use shadow alone, which keeps them separate without a tangle.
